contexts.quote: "Non-negligible initial quantum excitation populates sectors \\(k>0\\); a linear dipole connects \\(k\\) to \\(k\\pm1\\), so the vacuum formula no longer gives the complete thermal TCF. For \\(N\\) unrestricted bosonic modes, sector \\(k\\) has dimension \\(\\binom{N+k-1}{k}\\), and sectors through \\(K\\) have dimension \\(\\binom{N+K}{K}\\). Fixed small \\(K\\) remains polynomial; finite local cutoffs can reduce these counts.",
contexts.where: “Failure of this reduction does not establish classical hardness: quadratic thermal models and fixed excitation cutoffs retain polynomial classical descriptions.”
